name: Jotform MCP
description: Lets agents search, create, and edit Jotform forms, read and analyze submissions, and send Jotform Sign documents over a hosted OAuth MCP server.

skills.name: Form Creation
skills.description: Creates a new form from a description and edits an existing form from instructions through the Jotform MCP server.

skills.name: Submission Retrieval
skills.description: Retrieves a form's responses with date filters, sorting, and pagination, or fetches a single submission's details.

skills.name: Submission Analysis
skills.description: Summarizes form responses with statistics, trends, and insights using the analyze_submissions tool.

skills.name: Jotform Sign Documents
skills.description: Creates and edits signable documents, manages signers, sends signature requests, and tracks signing progress.

skills.name: Form Assignment
skills.description: Assigns a form to an email recipient, user, or group with a personalized message from inside the AI client.
